subject: MAP -> signature sequencing and evaluation runway for Averon pilot
messages:
From: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@averonhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Averon Procurement <procurement@averonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP + procurement sequencing questions

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Averon is excited to move the pilot forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a few sequencing items before we lock in dates:

- Do you have a recommended order for MSA / DPA / Order Form signature?
- We need a concise MAP with milestones + owners so our legal and procurement teams can reserve review windows.
- Is SOC 2 evidence required before signing, or can it be provided during onboarding?

I attached a short spreadsheet with our internal gating checklist. Can we aim for a 4–6 week runway from PO to pilot launch?

If helpful, can you share a sample order form and a proposed MAP by end of day Thursday?

Best,
Anna Brooks
Sr. Procurement Manager | Averon Health
anna.brooks@averonhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@averonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + procurement sequencing questions

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a concise mutual action plan and a suggested sequencing for the legal artifacts. High level answers first:

- Recommended sequencing: 1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) + Evaluation SOP agreed, 2) DPA redline concurrent with MSA review (parallel), 3) Order Form finalized and signed last (ties billing/term specifics to MSA).
- SOC 2 summary can be shared at contracting and the full report can be provided under NDA; evidence is not a blocker for signature but procurement often asks for the summary during order finalization.
- 4–6 week runway is realistic if we lock milestones this week and Averon legal reserves 1 week for MSA comments and procurement reserves 3 business days for PO processing.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owner, target):
- M1: MAP sign-off (Averon Procurement / Redwood AE) — target: 2024-05-17
- M2: Legal redlines submitted (Averon Legal) — target: 2024-05-24
- M3: Redwood responds to redlines / DPA sync (Redwood Legal) — target: 2024-05-27
- M4: Finalize Order Form (Commercial Ops / Averon Procurement) — target: 2024-05-29
- M5: PO issued & onboarding kickoff (Averon / Redwood CS) — target: 2024-06-03

Key dependencies and fallbacks:
- If MSA redlines are material, we propose a parallel path to sign an interim Order Form with a limited pilot scope (timebox + usage cap) and attach an escalation clause for expanded production.
- DPA items (data residency, subprocessor list) can be toggled per pilot scope — if you need a stricter DPA we should put that in the MAP as a gating item and plan an extra week.

I attached a one-page MAP and a sample Order Form. Laura + Kim — can you review the sequencing and flag any legal/commercial risk?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Office: +1 (510) 555-0199

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@averonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + procurement sequencing questions

Thanks — a couple of legal clarifications from my side:

- We prefer to complete the MSA and DPA redlines before final Order Form signature to reduce the need for contract side letters later. For pilot-only scope we can offer a limited Order Form (pilot SOW + capped spend) to accelerate onboarding, but the MSA/DPA must be at least in a reviewed state (commented) to accept an interim order.
- Data processing items that typically add time: custom retention, exportability clauses, and additional security attestations. If Averon requires an in-region hosting guarantee beyond our standard regions, that will add procurement time — please flag if that's needed.
- SOC 2: summary + control mapping is fine to share pre-signature. Full SOC 2 report requires an NDA/secure transfer and is usually provided at order finalization.

Action: I will prioritize Redwood legal review of any redlines submitted by 2024-05-24 and aim for consolidated comments within 3 business days.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Anna — adding commercial ops details. Attached: redwood_sample_orderform_v1.pdf (fillable) and SOC2_report_summary.pdf. Quick notes:

- Order form fields that Averon should confirm: billing contact, tax information, pilot usage cap, renewal option, and invoice cadence.
- For pilot acceleration we can accept a signed Order Form with an attached email acknowledgment of outstanding legal items, provided Procurement confirms PO issuance date.
- Pricing: pilot discounted rate (see Order Form appendix). If Averon needs an earlier start date we can provision a limited-credit invoice to cover the first 2 weeks until PO clears.

Please complete the Order Form draft and return to me; I will coordinate PO and billing lane once we have the signed doc.

Kimberly Park
